# Cargo MCP Skybridge - LLMs.txt

## Project Overview
- **Name**: cargo-mcp-skybridge
- **Type**: MCP Server / API Documentation Tool
- **Framework**: Skybridge (MCP Apps)
- **Description**: Interactive API documentation MCP app for the Cargoffer B2B logistics platform
- **Repository**: https://github.com/cargoffer/cargo-mcp-skybridge

## Capabilities
- Search API endpoints by keyword
- View detailed endpoint documentation
- Explore schema definitions
- Navigate API by tags
- Multi-locale support (Spanish, English)

## Tools Available (7)
1. **search_docs** - Search Cargoffer API docs by keywords
2. **get_endpoint** - Get specific endpoint details
3. **list_modules** - List all API modules
4. **get_navigation** - Get module navigation by tags
5. **search_by_tag** - Find endpoints by tag
6. **get_schema** - Retrieve schema definitions
7. **list_schemas** - List all schemas for module

## Modules Covered (3)
- **company**: 52 endpoints - Authentication, users, billing, addresses
- **truckers**: 103 endpoints - Carriers, auctions, offers
- **vehicle-types**: 84 endpoints - Vehicle specs, pricing

## Supported Queries
- "authentication", "login", "register", "password"
- "user", "profile", "update user"
- "address", "billing", "invoice"
- "trucker", "carrier", "auction", "bid"
- "vehicle", "type", "pricing"

## Tech Stack
- Node.js >= 22.0.0
- Skybridge @skybridge/core
- @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
- React 18+
- TypeScript

## Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/cargoffer/cargo-mcp-skybridge.git
cd cargo-mcp-skybridge
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

## Configuration
MCP server runs on http://localhost:3000/mcp

## Use Cases
- Integration assistance
- API exploration
- Schema lookup
- Documentation search
- Code generation reference
